title: Ngā rautau e iwa o te karangatanga
intro: Whakaarohia te tū takitahi i mua i te tai o te tawai mō te roa atu i te aranga me te hinganga o ngā emepaea, e karanga ana i te pō me te ao, me te hipoki o ngā taringa, me te kumea o ngā kākahu. Kei mua i a koe tētahi waka i hangaia ki runga i te whenua maroke me ngā wai kāore i kitea i mua. Ka taea e koe te rongo i te manawanui i muri i tēnei tere o te pōwhiri?
clues: I karanga ahau i tōku iwi i te ao, i te pō, i te huna, i te tūmatanui hoki, kia karakia ki a Allah anake.
I kuhu mai taku iwi i ō rātou maihao ki roto ki ō rātou taringa, ā, i takai i ō rātou kākahu ki te tahuri ke i ahau.
I noho ahau i waenganui i tōku iwi mō ngā tau e iwa rau e rima tekau, e karanga ana i a rātou ki te arataki.
I hanga e au tētahi oko i raro i ngā kanohi o Allah me āna whakakitenga, i te mea e tawai ana taku iwi ki ahau i runga i te whenua maroke.
I whakahaua ahau kia kawe takirua i runga i te waka, o ia momo, o ia momo, me te hunga whakapono hoki, i te taenga mai o te whakahau, ā, ka puea ake te oumu.
I mātakitaki ahau i ngā ngaru e ara ake ana me he maunga, i te waipuke e toremi ana i te hunga i whakakahore, i te mea i whakaorangia e Allah te hunga i roto i te Āraka.
